name: Accra
tagline: West Africa's Friendliest City with Beaches, Culture, and Growing Modernity
description: Accra is one of Africa's most welcoming cities for expats, with English as the official language, a stable democracy, and a warm, open culture that makes newcomers feel at home quickly. The city offers Atlantic Ocean beaches, a vibrant nightlife and music scene rooted in highlife and afrobeats, and a rapidly modernizing infrastructure. For FIRE retirees, Accra delivers strong value with affordable housing, excellent tropical fruit and seafood, and a growing community of international residents. Ghana's Year of Return initiative has made the country especially popular with African American retirees.

quickFacts.visa: Visa required for US citizens (available on arrival or online, 60 days). Right to Abode permit for long-term stays. No dedicated retirement visa — residence permits available through investment or extended stay applications.
quickFacts.safetyRating: Good – one of the safest countries in West Africa
quickFacts.climate: Tropical savanna with hot temperatures year-round and a rainy season

housing.description: Modest but secure gated apartment (24/7 guard, generator, water tank) on the East Legon fringe, Osu, or Labone — the security premium prime pockets command

dining.description: Chop-bar and local eats a few times a week; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: Basic local/regional private cover for a 45–55 early retiree, hospitalization-first

transportation.description: Bolt/Uber daily plus the occasional trotro; no car

1M.lifestyle: A modest but secure gated apartment on the East Legon fringe, Osu, or Labone, where the 24/7 guard, generator, and water tank are the security premium prime pockets command. Most meals are cooked at home from local markets, with chop-bar plates a few times a week, and getting around is by Bolt and the occasional trotro rather than a car. Cover is a no-frills local/regional plan handling hospitalization and basic outpatient care. AC use is rationed against the prepaid meter, and dumsor means the inverter earns its keep. Frugal and careful, but genuinely comfortable and safe — no imported-grocery habit and little travel.

housing.description: Upscale furnished apartment in Osu, Labone, or Cantonments

dining.description: Out several nights a week, local + mid-range

healthcare.description: Comprehensive regional private cover (Nyaho, Akai House access)

entertainment.description: Gym plus a regular social life

2M.lifestyle: An upscale furnished apartment in Osu, Labone, or Cantonments, within walking distance of restaurants and nightlife. Groceries mix Makola-market local produce with imported items, and dinners out several nights a week are routine. Comprehensive regional private insurance covers the good private clinics like Nyaho and Akai House. Daily Bolt rides replace the trotro entirely, and a gym membership plus an active weekend social life round out an easy, unpretentious lifestyle.

housing.description: Good furnished/serviced flat in a prime pocket (Cantonments, Airport Residential) with 24h security, backup power, gym

dining.description: Frequent quality dining at Accra's better restaurants

healthcare.description: Strong private plan approaching international, with regional referral

transportation.description: Own car or unlimited Bolt plus an occasional hired day-driver

entertainment.description: Clubs, gym, weekend trips to Cape Coast, Ada, or Aburi

3M.lifestyle: A good furnished/serviced flat in a prime pocket like Cantonments or Airport Residential — 24-hour security, backup power, and a gym come built in, which matters when dumsor hits. Dining at Accra's better restaurants becomes a default, and transport is either an owned car or unlimited Bolt with an occasional hired day-driver. Insurance steps up to a strong plan approaching international cover, with regional referral. Weekends mean Cape Coast, Ada, or the Aburi hills, with real budget margin left over each month.

5M.lifestyle: A top luxury serviced flat in Cantonments or Airport Residential, with a part-time housekeeper/cook and a part-time driver handling an owned car. Dining is near-daily at Accra's top spots, backed by a club or beach-club membership and frequent regional travel. Healthcare is a top-tier international plan (worldwide-excl-US) with evacuation cover to South Africa or Europe. A full-AC home with its own generator means dumsor is somebody else's problem, and discretionary spending is easy.

housing.description: Top-luxury flat or a villa at the best address (Cantonments, Airport Residential)

healthcare.description: International concierge cover with worldwide access and evacuation

transportation.description: Car(s), fuel, maintenance, premium rides (driver under domesticHelp)

luxuryExtras.description: Concierge, club tiers, art/hobbies, lavish discretionary

10M.lifestyle: Top-of-market luxury in Accra — a premium flat or a villa at the best address in Cantonments or Airport Residential, staffed by a full-time housekeeper, cook, and driver. Daily fine dining and hosting, first-class regional and international travel, and an international concierge health plan with worldwide access and evacuation. A large villa runs on its own generator against dumsor, and the discretionary budget funds concierge services, club tiers, and hobbies. This is the full extent of the opulence Accra offers — a prime address, staff on hand, and lavish travel.
